source_row.extraction_instructions: DNN site; three server-rendered listing modules (conferences, courses, webinars) whose div.article blocks hold title, link and a date footer ('Loading more' is vestigial, TotalCount equals the blocks present). Stale or missing card dates (Annual Conference, undated webinar) are re-read from the detail page's Date line; on-demand courses are skipped. Detail pages: Date / Venue / CPD labels plus a Members / Non-members pricing tab (ex VAT).
